paragraphs: Hinak, the name of a Tanna or Amora. Rabbi Idi bar Avin said to Rav Chisda, “This is how we recite it in Rav Hinak’s baraita”; some say, “of the house of Bar Hinak”: Arvei Pesachim 101b.
